lines.zh: 我顺着墙根移过去，脚不落地。
lines.en: I move along the skirting, my feet never touching the floor.

lines.zh: 我从一片暗走到另一片暗里。
lines.en: I pass out of one patch of dark into another.
I stop at your back.
I move as if something were dragging me.

lines.zh: 我从门底下那条缝里过去了。
lines.en: I slipped under the gap beneath the door.

lines.zh: 我贴着柱子绕过去，一点声都没有。
lines.en: I rounded the pillar without making any sound.
My edges keep quivering.
I move toward where you stand.

lines.zh: 灯在我经过时矮了一截。
lines.en: The lamp burns lower as I pass.

lines.zh: 我同墙上那道黑影合成了一体。
lines.en: I have merged with the dark shape on the wall.

lines.zh: 我边走边把眼睛对着你。
lines.en: I keep my eyes on you as I move.
I paused once, then moved on.
I stand in this patch of dark.
My face stays forever smudged.
I am counting how often you breathe.

lines.zh: 我把手举到胸口那么高。
lines.en: I lift a hand to chest height.
I put no weight on anything.

lines.zh: 我在等你转身的那一下。
lines.en: I am waiting for the instant you turn.
The light in this room is thin.
I turn my body away an inch at a time.
The dark on me keeps flowing.
I am not cold, but you will be, near me.
I keep to the wall the lamp cannot reach.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势很久了。
lines.en: I have held this pose a long while.

lines.zh: 你的脚步我一下下记着。
lines.en: I am marking your steps one by one.
I sank half an inch.

lines.zh: 我离你这么近，你还是看不清。
lines.en: I am this close, and you still cannot see me.
Your eyes closed for a moment.
I moved one step nearer.
Your feet have not moved.
I raise my gaze to your face.
You are tracing my outline.

lines.zh: 我在你瞳孔里看见自己的影子。
lines.en: I see my own shape in your pupils.
Your breathing has gone shallow.
I neither harm you nor save you.

lines.zh: 我从很早起就在这屋子里。
lines.en: I have been in this room since long ago.
You need not be so afraid of me.
And yet your hands are shaking.
I come an inch closer again.
Your back is against the wall now.
That blot of black on the wall is me.
I will not reach out and touch you.
No breath comes with my words.

lines.zh: 你听见我刚才那句了吗。
lines.en: Did you catch what I just said?
In the moment you look back, I am still here.

lines.zh: 这不是我们第一次照面。
lines.en: This is not our first meeting.
I thinned once, then thickened again.
I am keeping account of that.
My outline went ragged for a moment.
I withdrew and returned to the same spot.
Not pain; only dispersion.
You carry something that can wound me.
I stand perfectly still.

lines.zh: 我地上的影子抖了一下。
lines.en: My shadow on the floor shuddered.
I drew myself upright again.
Another blow will change nothing.
I do not live on food.

lines.zh: 你举着的东西没有影子。
lines.en: What you hold casts no shadow.
To me that is the same as nothing.
I only need you to be alone.
I turn my face aside.
That will not stir me.
I spared it a glance.
You eat this one yourself.

lines.zh: 我的手指穿不过这种实心东西。
lines.en: My fingers cannot pass through something this solid.
It fell; I do not care.
All you meet is cold.
I yield back and press in again.
My darkness touched you first.

lines.zh: 你从肩到脚都僵了一下。
lines.en: You went stiff from shoulder to foot.
I tilt my head away.
That kind of impact cannot reach me.
You drew back; I did not move.
My edge scattered for an instant.
I congealed back into shape.
I did not even give way.
I lost that part of me long ago.
That would turn into something else.
I fade backward into blankness.
Nothing answers from the mirror.
The one you ask for is not here.

lines.zh: 我连自己有没有身子都不确定。
lines.en: I am not sure I have a body at all.
I shook my head, slowly.
I have faded nearly out of sight.
That is not why I came.
I settle back into that patch of dark.

lines.zh: 我一伸手，它自己浮起来。
lines.en: I reach, and it lifts on its own.
It slides through my palm.

lines.zh: 我把它摆回原来的位置。
lines.en: I put it back exactly where it was.
I have no use for this.
I studied it for a long time.
It goes cold in my hand.
I let it drop back.

lines.zh: 这不像你平时带的东西。
lines.en: This is not the sort of thing you carry.
It ages in my hand.
I will not put a hand to this.
I have stopped moving.
You see me at last.
I am square to your face.
The wick jumped.
Both my hands have come up.
The room has gone unnaturally quiet.
I have pinned your position.
There is no need to come close.
You can hear your own heartbeat.
There is no door behind you now.
Looking them over, still you.
Tonight will be strangely quiet.
Each step of mine takes a degree from you.
My mouth moved; you did not see.
I have never truly left.
This moment before me.
I follow without a step between us.

lines.zh: 你去了哪间屋子，我都在。
lines.en: Whichever room you take, I am in it.
I am in the corridor mirror.
I hang at your back.
Your breath is getting shorter.
My hand rests at your nape.
I need neither to sprint nor run.
You look back and find only empty air.
I stay at the rim of your sight.
The lamps go out one after another.
I speak at your ear.

lines.zh: 你已经说不清我在哪边。
lines.en: You can no longer say which side I am on.
Your steps are beginning to drift.
I am not hurrying in the least.

lines.zh: 我能在你影子里待上一整夜。
lines.en: I can stay in your shadow the whole night.
It makes no difference how fast you go.
I have already shut the door.
Further on there is no path.
I watch without a single blink.
I have been waiting for this all along.
My palm settles on your face.
There is no warmth in that.
You feel no pain, only a cold in the chest.
I tugged at your shadow.
You did not fall, but you cannot stand straight.
I came close enough to hear you.
I drew half a step back and watched.
Your fingers will not stop trembling.
That came from behind you.
I used no strength.
You did not even cry out.
I gave you one chance.
I have pressed in again.
This time I lingered longer.
Your eyes are hunting for light.
Your knees are giving.
The lamp dropped an inch first.
My darkness settled on the floor first.
The black on the wall arrived before I did.
I am standing behind the door.
The air has chilled by a degree.
I rise slowly from the floor.

lines.zh: 你一转过来，我已经在了。
lines.en: You turn, and I am already there.
A piece of the room's light is gone.
I surface out of the corner.

lines.zh: 地上那团影子不归任何人。
lines.en: That shadow on the floor belongs to no one.
I do not even have footsteps.
I lifted one hand.
The night has grown heavy.
I have never been far from you.

lines.zh: 我在这儿立了一会儿了。
lines.en: I have stood here for a while.
That blackness behind you is me.
I turn my shape slowly.
There are two figures on this wall.
I have drawn a little closer.
I wait for you to find me yourself.

lines.zh: 火一照，整间屋子亮了，我缩回墙角。
lines.en: The fire lights the whole room and I shrink into the corner.

lines.zh: 我落下去的时候，影子还挂在上头。
lines.en: As I fall, my shadow stays behind.

lines.zh: 水灌过我的形状，散掉了一半。
lines.en: Water pours through my shape and half of it disperses.

lines.zh: 那一下的白光把整面墙都照透了。
lines.en: The flash lit the entire wall through.

lines.zh: 有东西从我中间穿过去，留下一个空洞。
lines.en: Something passed through my middle, leaving a hollow.

lines.zh: 一股力把我钉在原地，我挣不动。
lines.en: Some force nailed me in place and I cannot work free.

lines.zh: 没人再怕我了，我就越来越淡。
lines.en: No one fears me now, and I thin by the hour.

lines.zh: 白光一劈，我散成了几片。
lines.en: The white bolt struck and I scattered into pieces.

lines.zh: 脚下一空，我连影子也没了。
lines.en: The ground fell away, and even my shadow is gone.
